properties: The preregistration manifest and trial plan remain unable to self-authorize execution.

A separately issued RED authorization binds the exact source, canonical manifest, plan, composite inventory, Runtime Base manifest, Engine Pack ID and manifest, opaque actor, confirmation receipt, nonce, UTC issue/expiry window, and immutable zero-provider caps.
The authorization window is at most eight hours and permits only five minutes of clock skew before issue time.
The Engine Pack source must exactly equal the repository execution subject.
Each scenario reserves all ten trials in a durable dispatch_attempted transition before external I/O; failed or indeterminate creation therefore cannot disappear from the 60-trial denominator.
A terminal scenario accounts for all ten completed, failed, timeout, cancelled, or indeterminate trials and carries a content-addressed observation receipt.
Terminal work cannot be overwritten or automatically retried.
Only one PX4/Gazebo scenario may be dispatching or running at once because the frozen vehicle profile uses PX4 instance 0.
Transition hashes bind before/after ledgers, scenario, action, and UTC time.

root_causes: The transition hash payload contained a Python datetime while canonical_sha256 intentionally accepts JSON values only.
Pydantic model_copy(update=...) would not fully revalidate changed state by default.
Ruff found one overlong line and Mypy rejected broad dynamic transition construction and non-Final Literal constants.
preserved_failure.fix: Hash explicit ISO-8601 UTC values, construct typed transitions explicitly, and revalidate every updated scenario and ledger through the strict versioned models.
